title: Kamailio – 25 Years Of Development
html:
And so it started, 25 years ago:

~/kamailio # git log --reverse

commit 512dcd9838f5aeb0bfccd02cfc156067b7f02b71
Author: Andrei Pelinescu-Onciul <andrei@iptel.org>
Date: Mon Sep 3 21:27:11 2001 +0000

Initial revision

With 28 major releases and hundreds of minor releases, with about 250 modules, done by over 500 contributors, the development of Kamailio (SER) kept always a high pace over a quarter of a century. The developers and the community help the project evolve and reach milestones that probably not many imagined when it started, creating a flexible and robust application renowned across the world.

Fourteen editions of Kamailio World Conference were organised, offering the place for people to meet, share their knowledge and strengthen the relations.

The list of people to thank to is too large to include here, but expecting in a way or another that the involvement in the Kamailio project brought everyone many benefits and satisfaction!

Hopefully everyone is eager to see what future for Kamailio project can be built, continuing to leverage the open source spirit and the community collaboration!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
